title: Refuse a lane push on a PR whose FAIL round has no posted record
note: Title read from the slug; the coordinator was asked for a one-line goal. Goal line (timing lane, as fail-record-before-fix, via coordinator 12:38 CST Nov 9): before a lane pushes a fix after a FAIL, it posts the FAIL record at the reviewed head, or the merge tool refuses the later fix check. Fix: the merge tool, or the review brief guard, refuses a push after a FAIL round with no record at that head.
